purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility, insurance coverage, employer identity or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: The current public work-injury dental route is actor-labeled as employee even though the statutory truth conditions are not an employee-only gate, while the product lacked a permanent distinction between own-business status and egenanstallning through an invoicing company.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the existing Forsakringskassan work-injury dental truth conditions intact, add permanent self-employed and egenanstalld synthetic regressions, forbid automatic Afa coverage or automatic exclusion from the statutory route, and require actual insurance/employer context to be verified before any future public handoff is generalized.
